slug: 2022-04-28 Interoperability of CRVS and EIR systems for improved EPI management in Rwanda

facts.fact: DHIS2 states that the NCI-CRVS system was launched in 2020 and that birth and death, with cause of death, were its first two modules deployed.

DHIS2 states that a birth is registered at the health facility: a data manager or nurse enters the newborn in the CRVS system, the health centre head or nursing and midwifery director registers it, and a national identity number is issued and sent to the parent by message; the document gives no date for the practice, so its publication date is used.

systems.tiers: health facilities, where births are registered

systems.system: Web-based application for civil status events
systems.owner: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda, with the Ministry of Local Government, the Ministry of Health and NIDA
systems.tiers: collection, storage and production of data on civil status events; where it is used is not stated
interoperable with CRVS through a unique identification number assigned at birth

systems.system: CRVS link to the Electronic Immunization Registry
systems.platform: DHIS2 Tracker in the national HMIS; a custom script pushes registered newborns from CRVS
systems.owner: Ministry of Health EPI programme, supported by HISP Rwanda
systems.tiers: all public and private health facilities offering routine vaccination; integration built in 2021 and early 2022, complete and validated as of April 2022
online portal where the digital birth certificate is requested with the child's national identity number
